title: Cult UI: shadcn components plus 92+ AI SDK agent patterns
summary: Cult UI is an MIT Tailwind/shadcn-compatible component library paired with 92+ live-preview AI SDK agent patterns and Cult Pro templates, including directory/SEO starters and Firecrawl-based research agents.
question_it_answers: Where can I copy marketing UI blocks and ready-made AI SDK agent architectures in one place?

claims.text: Cult UI bundles copy-paste React components with agent pattern examples such as competitor research via Firecrawl map+scrape and a Cult SEO directory template.
claims.evidence: Competitor Research Agent — Firecrawl Map + Parallel Scrape; Starter templates: Logo GPT, Directory (SEO listings), Cult SEO
claims.subject: landing-ui-motion

claims.text: Cult Pro pricing page (2026-09-04) shows one-time lifetime access at $129 (was $179, Summer Sale $50). FAQ: Annual updates last 1 year; Lifetime updates last the product lifetime. aisdkagents.com is a separate product, not included with Cult Pro.
claims.evidence: pro.cult-ui.com/pricing: $129 vs struck $179; RSC FAQ states aisdkagents.com is completely separate; Annual = 1 year of updates, Lifetime = lifetime of the product.
claims.subject: landing-ui-motion

claims.text: Live hero strings (2026-09-04): Cult Pro “Shadcn blocks for marketing.” / “Ship your ideas.Even if you don't code.”; Originkit title “Free Animated component library for modern websites” (no SSR h1); Vengeance “Next-Gen UI Interactions” / “Ship landing pages at lightspeed”. Cult OSS homepage still 429. Fetched CSS has no mobile breakpoint besides the Cult challenge page.
